name: narrated-film
description: Turn screenshots, screen footage and audio into a finished narrated video, entirely on your own machine — no cloud service and no API key. Local text-to-speech in one consistent cloned voice, a content gate that transcribes every line back and rejects takes that say the wrong words, ffmpeg assembly with ducked narration beds and before/after A/B beats, reusable branded intro and end cards, channel art, and a verifier that checks the finished film with positive controls.
